description: `str` is Unicode text (code points); `bytes` is raw data. `encode` and `decode` convert between them.
The rule that maps characters to bytes. UTF-8 is the common default for text.
`unicodedata.normalize('NFC', s)` composes characters so visually identical strings compare equal.
Aggressive lowercasing for caseless comparison (`'ß'` becomes `'ss'`). Prefer it over `lower()` for matching.
The mini-language after `:` in an f-string: alignment, width, precision, type, for example `{price:>8.2f}`.
